استقبحن (form X)
# اِسْتَقْبَحْنَ (istaqbaḥna) /is.taq.baħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# اُسْتُقْبِحْنَ (ustuqbiḥna) /us.tuq.biħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# اِسْتَقْبِحْنَ (istaqbiḥna) /is.taq.biħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
